notes:
User is training for multiple sports:

- Upcoming charity 5K: wants to beat their personal best of 25:50. They have previously run a 5K in 27:12, so the newer 25:50 best supersedes it. They want endurance, pacing, interval, and strength guidance. Favor individualized, injury-conscious plans over rigid weekly mileage increases; balance hard intervals/easy runs, strength, recovery, nutrition, and race pacing.
- Recreational soccer with coworkers roughly every two weeks; next game was estimated in two weeks but date is unconfirmed. They recently scored a goal, a notable highlight because they do not usually score. Goals: improve endurance, running technique, and shooting. Core/leg strength work has helped running and games.
- First real tennis tournament is May 6 (year unspecified), with a goal of reaching at least the quarterfinals. They have played casually for a few years and are currently focused on improving serve toss consistency, serves, and volleys; later plan to work on footwork and returns.
- Equipment advice should cover racket size/weight/balance, grip size, strings/type/tension/pattern/gauge, and hybrid setups, but recommend demoing/testing equipment and avoid prescribing a model before knowing dominant hand, swing style, skill level, and preferences.

Important correction from prior advice: do not prescribe a forehand grip for serving based solely on handedness; both forehand and backhand serves generally use a Continental grip. Toss drills should prioritize repeatable release, relaxed straight-arm motion, consistent location slightly in front of and toward the hitting side, and tracking the ball; avoid advice that forces an “elbow locked” position or claims that catching the toss with the same hand directly improves serving. Advice should remain safety-conscious, practical, and tailored to a recreational/intermediate athlete.
